mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair sirolimus clearance and increase nephrotoxic synergy, while sirolimus immunosuppression increases CMV disease risk in patients requiring foscarnet.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and sirolimus levels closely; ensure adequate hydration with foscarnet; consider alternative antivirals if possible; assess benefit-risk in transplant patients.
